ov: Slow, quiet nocturnal primates of Southeast Asia with big reflective eyes and stubby tails hidden in their fur. They have a toxic bite, rare among mammals and unique among primates. When threatened, they freeze instead of running.

why.dg: Its bite is toxic, which is rare among mammals. It gets the toxin by licking a gland on its arm, and saliva activates it.
why.ac: All slow lorises are nocturnal primates.

rg: From Bangladesh and Northeast India east to the southern Philippines, and from Yunnan in China south to Java.
df: Omnivores: small animals, fruit, tree gum and other plants.
fx: Slow lorises see in shades of only one colour.
Demand from the exotic pet trade and traditional medicine is the biggest cause of their decline.
